narrative.overview:
Gotchu reads like a case file someone has already worked through with a pen: giant wide uppercase headlines that unmask line by line, a highlighter swept across the phrases that matter, numbered margin notes beside the paragraphs they qualify, hairline rules between entries, and a few plates of authored art. The ground is a complete white or a complete black and nothing sits on it as a panel; structure comes from rules, columns and type size, not from cards. The brand speaks through magenta used sparingly as ink and highlighter, never as a filled section.

Art is digital and made of the world's own materials: ASCII plates drawn from a character grid (the snapshot folder with its fingerprint, the two overlapping looks) and dot fields of square pixels and glyphs on canvas (the `[◆]` mark in the hero, the domain globe, the closing GOTCHU wordmark). The finding diamond `◆` is the only coloured glyph. The fields ripple away from a fine pointer, gather on their finding while a primary action is hovered or focused, and hold still when paused. Content is real product vocabulary (SHA-256, `_gotchu.<dominio>`, report JSON keys) and is never padded with invented results.

The landing follows a light, dark or system theme. Every rule below holds in both; values are shadcn tokens scoped to `.gl` so they cannot restyle `/dashboard` or `/demo`. The previous graphite landing at `/variantes/anterior` is a comparison fixture and is not described here.
keyCharacteristics: Pure white (light) or pure black (dark) ground; graphite or porcelain ink; magenta as highlighter, bullet, rule and finding.

One Saira variable file in two faces: Gotchu Display (125% width, 700, uppercase) for headlines, Gotchu Text (100% width) for reading and controls; ui-monospace for notes, labels, code and the DNS record.
Editorial devices: line-unmask headlines, highlighter marks, superscript references to margin notes, drop cap, dotted leaders, 2px section rules.
shadcn/ui controls on Base UI, restyled: 8px corners, 34px floor, a hard magenta offset on hover.
ASCII and square-pixel dot fields only; every moving piece has a still state and a visible pause.

rules.name: The Small-Text Rule
rules.body: Small text never sits on signal magenta (#e7147d). Magenta takes display type, marks, rules and fields; small magenta text uses action on white and pink ink on black; body highlights use pink ink behind graphite (light) or action behind porcelain (dark).

rules.name: The Two Grounds Rule
rules.body: The light ground is #ffffff and the dark ground is #000000, never graphite. Graphite survives only as light-theme ink and the light-theme footer band.

rules.name: The Highlighter Rule
rules.body: Magenta enters the page as a stroke, not a field: a band behind a phrase, a 2px underline, an 8px diamond, a 2px rule. There are no magenta section fills and no gradients between colour fields.

rules.name: The Two-Width Rule
rules.body: Display is always 125% width, 700 and uppercase with slight negative tracking; every reading line and every control label is in the 100% text face. Reading copy is never set in the display cut.

rules.name: The Licence Rule
rules.body: AIRNT is a visual reference only. Ship Saira (OFL, licence file alongside the woff2); never embed or distribute AIRNT without licence evidence.

rules.name: The Hard Offset Rule
rules.body: Shadows are never blurred and never ambient. The 4px solid magenta offset appears only as a response to hover on a filled button; reduced motion removes the shift.

rules.name: The Flat Ground Rule
rules.body: Content sits on the ground, not on panels. No bevels, gloss, metal, glass, blur, realistic lighting or solid 3D renders.

rules.name: The Small Radius Rule
rules.body: Radius never exceeds 16px and always comes from the scale; a radius softens a corner, it does not change the silhouette. No pills, no circles (badges map to 6px).

dos: **Do** size every control at 34px minimum: header buttons, menu trigger, toggles, the FAQ control, links and pause. Desktop primary buttons are 48px, large ones 56px. Keep 8px or more between adjacent controls.
**Do** keep the light ground #ffffff and the dark ground #000000, with every colour taken from the `.gl` tokens so both themes share each rule.
**Do** take every radius from the scale: 2px pixels, 6px chips, 8px controls, 12–16px panels and cards.
**Do** answer filled-button hover with the up-left 2px shift over the solid 4px magenta offset.
**Do** put small magenta text in action (light) or pink ink (dark), never in signal magenta.
**Do** build controls from the shadcn components in `src/components/ui/` and restyle them there; style navigation as buttons with `buttonVariants` on a real `<a>`.
**Do** set every headline in Gotchu Display 700 uppercase and every reading line and control label in Gotchu Text.
**Do** carry qualifying facts as numbered margin notes beside the paragraph they qualify.
**Do** mark every primary path into the product with `data-catch`.
**Do** give every moving piece a still state, a reduced-motion final state and a visible pause where it loops in the first viewport.
**Do** make art from ASCII and square-pixel dot fields authored in components.
donts: **Don't** use a graphite ground; graphite is ink and the light-theme footer only.
**Don't** fill sections with magenta or run gradients between colour fields.
**Don't** use pills, circles or any radius above 16px.
**Don't** blur a shadow, add ambient elevation, or make the header or menu translucent or blurred.
**Don't** use solid 3D objects, photos, metal, glass or any realistic render.
**Don't** add captions or helper copy that explain the artwork or the page.
**Don't** invent results, metrics, findings, customers or animated pseudo-data.
**Don't** set small text on signal magenta (#e7147d).
**Don't** ship or embed AIRNT; Saira is the licensed face.
**Don't** put a tag or mono line above a headline as a kicker, or bring back the index rail or section numerals.
**Don't** use custom cursors, scroll snapping or hijacking, a loader, or particles that cover content.
